name: strongman dumbbell one arm clean and jerk
description: A one arm dumbbell clean followed by a jerk overhead. Trains explosive power from the legs through the shoulder.
instructions: Stand over a dumbbell with feet shoulder width apart and grab it with one hand.
Pull it explosively to your shoulder with a hip drive, dipping slightly under it.
Dip your knees, then drive up and press the dumbbell overhead to a locked arm.
Lower it back to the shoulder and then the floor with control, then switch arms.
